title: Seeking feedback on a trading journal and analytics tool
author: Bubbly-Meal7934
selftext:
Hi everyone,
I’m a trader and developer working on a trading journal and stock analytics tool with AI-generated summaries and insights.
I’m looking for honest feedback from traders, especially on:
Useful journal features
Missing analytics or insights
Whether AI summaries add value
What you expect from a trading journal
If you’ve tried similar tools, what worked well or could be improved?
Thanks!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the one thing I'd actually use: tag every trade with the rule it was meant to follow, then split P&L into followed vs broke it. that split tells most people more than any summary. AI summaries only earn their spot if they point at a specific trade, a paragraph about discipline gets skipped by week two.

replies.author: Bubbly-Meal7934
replies.body: Thanks for the reply. Re trade rules: do you mean planned trade with entry, exit and other additonal buy/partial sell levels? If not, can you elaborate little more? Please have a look : https://stylepulse.in

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: not the price levels, more the setup itself. something like "only long after the first 15 min, above the open, stop under the low". each trade gets tagged with which setup it was and whether you actually followed it. the levels are per trade, the rule is what you're grading.

replies.author: Bubbly-Meal7934
replies.body: Nice input. I will add this feature.
